regions.name: Europe
regions.description: Represented by the European Ranger Federation, connecting rangers across the continent in conservation efforts.

regions.name: South America
regions.description: Home to the Amazon rainforest and incredible biodiversity, rangers protect some of the world's most vital ecosystems.

regions.name: North America
regions.description: From Arctic tundra to desert canyons, rangers safeguard vast wilderness areas and national parks.

regions.name: Africa
regions.description: Represented by the Game Rangers Association of Africa (GRAA), founded in 1970, with 2,500+ rangers across 20 countries protecting iconic wildlife.

regions.name: Oceania
regions.description: Spanning 24 countries and territories across Polynesia, Micronesia, Melanesia, Australia, and New Zealand.

regions.name: Central America
regions.description: From northern Mexico through the Selva Maya Corridor, Mesoamerican Reef, and Caribbean Islands, protecting critical biodiversity hotspots.

regions.name: Asia
regions.description: A region of incomparable richness in biodiversity, with rangers protecting diverse ecosystems from tropical forests to high mountains.
